originalSharedProposalUnchanged.status: UNADOPTED AND UNSENT. Fifteen proposed mechanical procedures with complete originals and current comparisons. No public spell, class access, review count, source book or cosmology is changed. All added procedures are explicit NEW proposals, not approval or runtime evidence.
originalSharedProposalUnchanged.casting: All fifteen retain Action and V/S/F. Use the actual casting class’s rank, school, minimum class level, independently acquired repertoire and base RP price. A legal cast commits costs, concentration transitions and ordinary Dissonance/Refrain before interruption. Failure, immunity, missing information and countering give no refund or restoration of old concentration. Use actual casting ability + PB for attacks and 8 + PB + that modifier for save DC; ordinary saves are binary. No generic upcast, additional Action or inferred class-card access.
originalSharedProposalUnchanged.time: Unless a card states otherwise, a minute ends at the caster’s tenth future original regular-start marker, excluding a start underway, or after 60 elapsed seconds if begun outside initiative. Retain original virtual markers or absolute deadlines through reorder, extra turns, absence and travel. Suppression never pauses a clock, refunds spent history or replays an application. Later saved-against casts do not dispel an older valid application. Extra turns do not supply extra periodic pulses, order opportunities or repeat saves.
originalSharedProposalUnchanged.information: Use actual established facts and each information protection’s real subject and generating-source scope. Hidden unprotected facts can be read; missing facts are not invented. An unavailable answer does not identify the hidden reason. Ordinary observed outcomes and inferences remain possible. No new faction roster, plane, moral axis, cosmic force, secret doctrine or guaranteed destiny is authored. The pending expedition reputation verdict is not presumed.
originalSharedProposalUnchanged.control: A successfully established hard whole-Action/turn component spends the shared source-character/target/encounter guard once. Its continued valid duration does not claim a new allowance each turn. Initial prevention leaves no banked component; later suppression retains the existing clock and spent history. A blocked component gets no unprinted fallback. Actual component immunities remain separate; creature type alone is no blanket mental immunity. Limited attack or movement restrictions do not become whole-Action denial merely because alternatives are unattractive.
originalSharedProposalUnchanged.newControlBindings: NEW binding for Dominate Person and Confusion: use the reviewed Enchantment compelled-budget arbitration and shared six-second outside-initiative control cycle, preserving already spent budgets on entry to real initiative. A valid order/table instruction receives its priority timestamp when issued or generated at that opportunity; simultaneous instructions use application order then stable source ID. A losing instruction gets no second budget and does not erase an earlier mandate. Actual ordinary Attack Actions use native attacks unless the card expressly limits them to one. Only actual required ordinary ammunition can be compelled; no optional finite resource, spell/RP, recharge, charge, special expendable ammunition, permanent property surrender, protected secret, knowing binding-oath violation, direct self-harm or knowingly suicidal route can be forced. Bonus Actions, Reactions and extra Actions remain target-controlled. Hostile conduct uses ordinary initiative before execution, never a free virtual pre-initiative attack.
originalSharedProposalUnchanged.newCompanionBinding: NEW for an actually eligible Humanoid under Dominate Person, or any eligible Confusion target, using an owner-attached companion chassis: use the actual original-owner regular attached phase, original profile and structural command/offense caps. No independent turn, dominator companion allowance or unwilling owner Bonus Action is created. A pending command reservation can be redirected only for this same companion in this same phase, under the reviewed Dominate Beast bridge; spent or another companion’s reservation cannot be stolen. A repeat WIS save occurs at the end of that real regular attached phase even when no instruction executed; this source-specific checkpoint adds no ordinary START/END, recharge or other condition tick. If no such phase is currently supplied, only an END-only six-second save schedule continues, with no orders/actions. On transitioning to actual phases, map the next unresolved save to the next regular phase end, preserve resolved saves and the original maximum, and never replay an opportunity. This extension is proposed explicitly; it is not already conferred by Dominate Beast.
originalSharedProposalUnchanged.newEndSaveBinding: NEW: Overwhelming Grief, Charm Monster, Erase Emotion and Phantasmal Killer use affected regular-END saves, including an affected current turn, without extra-turn saves. Outside initiative their first END-only save is at application +6 seconds and then each six seconds. On entering initiative map the next unresolved save to the next actual regular END, retain completed saves and the original absolute maximum, and do not add an immediate transition save. For an owner-attached target, use its actual regular attached-phase end with the same END-only fallback/transition above, granting no actions. Dominate Person and Confusion instead use their shared behavior cycle and companion binding.
originalSharedProposalUnchanged.newCompanionPulseBinding: NEW for Illusion Phantasmal Killer on an owner-attached companion: its periodic packet uses the beginning of the actual original-owner regular attached phase, after that phase’s required processing, under the same once-per-numbered-round exposure. It creates no independent START or other start-trigger event. If no actual phase exists, use only the six-second damage schedule and original deadline, granting no actions. Transition to a real phase maps the next unresolved pulse opportunity without replaying an initial or completed pulse. Its separately scheduled repeat save still follows the END-only bridge.
